notes.title: Mobile version + 11 languages + 32 new songs!
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45637782/76b1593c91f941d189e6bf0265e90fc5a8acca01.png"][/img][/p][p]+  ERAIASON is now available on mobile platforms.  Android version is available now on itch.io, coming soon to Google Play Store and iOS.[/p][p]+ You can now select from 11 languages.  The full list of available languages is:[/p][list][*][p]English[/p][/*][*][p]Arabic[/p][/*][*][p]Chinese[/p][/*][*][p]French[/p][/*][*][p]German[/p][/*][*][p]Hebrew[/p][/*][*][p]Hindi[/p][/*][*][p]Japanese[/p][/*][*][p]Norwegian[/p][/*][*][p]Russian[/p][/*][*][p]Serbian[/p][/*][/list][p]+ Added 32 new songs[/p][p]+ Add option to enable/disable Novelty Search algorithm (which can be computationally expensive and cause lag).[/p]
